.Synopsis for Marianas Waters...
Moderate to fresh trade winds and combined seas of 6 to 8 feet 
are expected through tonight. Then, a developing trade-wind surge
will produce moderate to strong winds and build seas to 7 to 10 
feet, leading to hazardous conditions for small craft Thursday 
through Friday.
